Long western cliff walls expose sedimentary layers at monumental scale while the opposite side adds lagoons, sand bars, settlements and bridge engineering. entities.whyWorthwhile: This was one of the research run's credible E5 landscapes: a coherent island-scale geological coast whose science transfers directly into spectacle, while still retaining worthwhile terrestrial scenery when boats cannot sail.
